projects.title: Pollution Controller
projects.summary: Web app for monitoring and managing pollution data from stations with real-time visualization.
projects.description: Pollution Controller is a web application built with Elixir and the Phoenix framework, designed to monitor and manage pollution data from various stations. Leveraging Ecto for data storage and retrieval, it enables real-time visualization and analysis of pollution levels across different locations.

projects.title: Darwin World
projects.summary: Ecosystem simulation where animals evolve, reproduce, and compete based on inherited genomes.
projects.description: A simulation inspired by Darwin's theory of evolution. Animals move across a map, consume grass for energy, and reproduce with traits inherited from their parents. Genome-driven behavior models natural selection as species balance survival and reproduction in a dynamic environment.

projects.title: Tower Defense
projects.summary: Strategy game where players place towers to stop waves of enemies along a path.
projects.description: Tower Defense challenges players to deploy different tower types that attack, slow down, or poison incoming enemies before they reach the end of the path. Built with Pygame, the game escalates in difficulty and rewards adaptive defensive strategies.

projects.title: Stock Management System
projects.summary: Business web app for managing clients, products, invoices, and stock analytics.
projects.description: A full-stack stock management system with a React frontend and a C# backend using Entity Framework. SQLite powers data storage, while dedicated modules handle clients, products, invoices, and data visualization for day-to-day business operations.
